full_judgment: 2. Short facts necessary to dispose this petition are that respondent Nos.1 and 2 as the plaintiffs filed Title Suit No.96 of 2010 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Gazipur for declaration of title and for recovery of khas possession. The suit being ready for peremptory hearing, hearing commended and witnesses were examined and it was fixed for hearing argument. At that stage, 3(tree) applications (i) for amendment of the plaint, (ii) to accept the interrogatories to cure the defect of party and (iii) to call for the records of the volume of village Court, were filed.
